cell_line.evidence: For the analysis of MSTi and Luteolin targets in SH-SY5Y cells, kinobead γ pulldowns were performed.

A proteome-wide analysis of kinase inhibition in SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cell line  using the kinobead assay identified the upstream kinases MST1/2 as two major targets of the small molecule inhibitor XMU-MP1 (hereafter, MSTi)and Luteolin.
